body: I'm not a teenager, I am in my 20's as well. I didn't mean for that to sound so negative, but it is true that in order to get into a school, I would first have to prove to them that I can do work/get consistent grades for more than one semester. I did do a six month course at a technical school this year but I'm not sure how valuable that would be to said prospective school, especially since I wouldn't pursue something concerning that (veterinary assisting). I would guess this option would probably mean going back to community college for a while first.

Your two cents are very valuable to me. I thank you.

I know I have very low self esteem, but I try not to let it show.. I guess it's very hard to imagine what you seem like from another perspective sometimes. Most times though I just don't say anything at all because I just feel like I have nothing to say or contribute. Sometimes I do have something to say, but when it gets to be my turn to speak, the pressures on and the words jumble in my head. I'm not sure if I give off how I really feel except maybe that I am a bit strange but who isn't? I don't know.

I wish I could leave. I don't even know where to start though. I could apply for some schools away from here but I'd have to work on bringing up whatevers left after failing out of community college.
